space.description: The space; default: the workspace's default space

class.description: semantic for a fact someone asserted, procedural for how something is done, episodic for what happened in a run or session

subject.description: One line naming what the record is about

text.description: The statement, at most 16 KiB. Secrets are masked before it is stored

project.description: A label such as a repository name, never a path. Without it the record belongs to every project

session.description: The harness session, as a label

share.description: Who may read it: private (you), space (everyone who reads the space) or group:<g>. Default: the deployer's default, private unless they chose space. Widening needs a person or a listed writer

validFrom.description: When the statement starts to hold, RFC 3339; default: now

validUntil.description: When it stops holding, RFC 3339, after validFrom; default: open

ttlDays.description: How many days to keep it; default: the class's, at most the class's maximum

origin.description: Who said it. Default: user-stated when a person records it at a terminal, else agent-inferred

constraints.description: Limits the source stated on use, such as "staging only"

supersedes.description: Records this one replaces: yours, in the same project and with the same access

idempotencyKey.description: A retry with the same key returns the first answer and writes nothing
